name: Baztan (Spain)
description: Square flag with a large red saltire over a field of red, yellow, green and white triangles, within a border of small triangles.
history: The flag of the valley of Baztan is composed of a great red cross of Saint Andrew surrounded by triangles of red, yellow, green and white or beige; the Department of Conservation and Restoration of Textiles of the Instituto del Patrimonio Cultural de España undertook the restoration of the historic flag.
